query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coverImageUrl IS NOT NULL AND coverImageUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coverImageUrl IS NULL OR coverImageUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_images
FROM news;
